item.title: SELF TM
item.description: SELF Turing Machine There exists a Turing machine named SELF that can generate its own code without any external input. For details on SELF, refer to Chapter 6 (first few pages) of the Theory of Computation book by Sipser. SELF is composed of two parts, A, B both Turing machines. First, A runs and leaves <B>, the description of TM B, on the tape. Then, B runs and analyses the contents of the tape to determine the description <A> of the Turing machine that left the contents on the tape.
